title: FloodGuard Refund Charge by Payment Method
content:
**Payment-method charge on refunds — FloodGuard Private Flood Policy**

A payment-method charge is kept from the refund: 2.5 percent of the refundable amount when the most recent payment was made by card; 1 percent when it was made by check; and nothing for any other method.

The method read is the payment method recorded on the most recent payment received on the premium account. The refundable amount is the credit balance less anything held back against another balance of the customer.

| Method recorded on the most recent payment | Charge kept from the refund |
|---|---|
| Card | 2.5 percent of the refundable amount |
| Check | 1 percent of the refundable amount |
| Any other method, such as EFT or a mortgagee check | nothing |

**Hypothetical examples** on a refundable amount of 200.00: most recent payment by card, 5.00 kept; by check, 2.00 kept; by EFT, nothing kept.
